# Data and scripts {.unnumbered}

All of the files used in these lessons are bundled in [r_skills_data.zip](r_skills_data.zip){download="r_skills_data.zip"}. Extracting it creates a folder called `r_skills` that contains an RStudio project (`r_skills.Rproj`) and the `data` and `scripts` folders. Lesson 1.2 walks you through opening the project.

If you only need a single file, download it below and save it to the folder listed beside it, inside your `r_skills` folder.
